Machine Learning

Machine Learning is a subset of Artificial Intelligence.
It allows computers to learn patterns from data.
Machine learning is used in prediction, recommendation systems and image recognition.

Artificial Intelligence

Artificial Intelligence is a branch of computer science.
It enables machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence.
AI is used in healthcare, education, robotics and automation.

Deep Learning

Deep Learning is a subset of Machine Learning.
It uses artificial neural networks with multiple layers.
Deep learning is commonly used in speech recognition, self-driving cars and medical image analysis.
